B4_DIAGNOSIS.hooks_ruled_out: Four SessionStart hooks fire per codex exec. Timed: herdr-agent-state.sh 0.03s (timeout 10), the UOS preflight hook 2.5s on its fallback path (timeout 120). Neither is near its bound. The 4-starts/3-completions pattern in the failed logs was interleaved logging of two hook groups, not a hang.
B4_DIAGNOSIS.root_cause: SLICE SIZE, not a broken lane, not prompting, not the environment.
B4_DIAGNOSIS.why_this_matters: AK-47-03 specifies bolt clearance as one worker, one bounded file set, one observable acceptance, and SUP-03 assigns Codex the integration lane on that basis. A monolithic 16-file review is the opposite shape. The contract predicted the failure and predicted the fix; three records blamed the tool.
B4_DIAGNOSIS.fix: One oracle per codex exec. 16 bounded invocations in place of one monolithic task.

SEQUENCING.order: B4 -> B1 -> B3 -> B2 -> B5 -> robustness
SEQUENCING.rationale: B4's fix is free and unblocks B1, which is the critical bottleneck (implementer is also the falsifier). B3 is one file. B2's cost dropped an order of magnitude once measured. So the cheap items deliver a working falsifier lane before the expensive ones start.

B2_cost_correction.prior_claim: needs the enumerator to evaluate Mojo mirror functions -- a small interpreter or a harness that calls the functions directly; real work, not a tweak
B2_cost_correction.measured: 87 of ~98 unexamined arms call ONLY PURE mirror functions (runtime_aligned, gateway_aligned, aligned, span_within_budget, owned_in, quoted_examples, immune_breaker, live, status_for). Only 11 touch world contact.
B2_cost_correction.consequence: No interpreter is needed. A generated Mojo probe can IMPORT the oracle module and CALL its mirror function over the enumerated domain -- the technique the detector already uses, extended one step. The earlier difficulty estimate was an order of magnitude too high.

B5_approach_correction.prior_claim: it is not clear the data plane can be verified by this architecture at all -- a model of a grep is a model of the author's belief about the grep
B5_approach_correction.correction: Modelling the grep is unnecessary. What must be shown is that the measurement is SENSITIVE to the thing it measures: perturb the real subject in a scratch copy and require the measurement to move. That technique already caught real defects by hand (argon dropped from allAgentId, an added FppService, the ledger attribution). Systematising it verifies the data plane in the only sense that matters.

ALWAYS_WORK_REQUIREMENT.operator_directive: make the system extremely reliable and robust, like ak 47 it must always work
ALWAYS_WORK_REQUIREMENT.reading: AK-47-02 steel receiver, extended from 'the invariants do not bend' to 'the mechanism runs under ordinary dirt'. For this plane that means: no oracle may crash, every adverse condition must yield a WELL-FORMED RECEIPT with an honest verdict, and no verdict may be undefined.
concrete_properties: R1 totality -- the verdict function is total: every counter state maps to exactly one verdict
R2 fail-closed on instrument absence -- a missing tool yields BLIND, never a crash and never a manufactured failure
R3 bounded -- every world contact passes through capture's timeout; no unbounded spawn
R4 adverse-input safe -- empty captures, malformed JSON, absent files and negative counts all produce an honest verdict
R5 the selftest covers every verdict path
ALWAYS_WORK_REQUIREMENT.method: A robustness simulation that runs every oracle under adverse conditions (stripped PATH, absent tools, missing subjects) and requires a parseable receipt from each. An oracle that crashes or emits malformed JSON fails R1-R4 regardless of what it reports when clean.
